BiblicalUsage: Aggan is a bowl or basin — a broad, hollow vessel. Moses took half the blood of the covenant and put it in basons at Sinai, sprinkling the rest on the altar; and the Song pictures the beloved's navel as a round goblet that never lacks wine.
TheologicalSignificance: A bowl is a bowl — Moses used it to hold the blood of the covenant, and the vessel is not the message.
